name: Five-Coordinate Punctured-Cube Pendant Obstruction
definition: Take $X=\{1,2,3,4\}$, $W=\{1\}$, $A=\{1,2,3\}$, and a new coordinate $e$. The family is $\{A\}\cup\{K\cup\{e\}:K\subseteq X, K\ne W\}$.
properties: It has 16 states on five active coordinates. Both $A$ and $X\setminus A=\{4\}$ are at Hamming distance two from the missing singleton $W$, so the family is nonlearning while every proper coordinate contraction is learning.
